HELLO.how: Flat hand starts at the side of the forehead and moves out, like a salute.

THANK-YOU.how: Fingertips of a flat hand touch the chin, then the hand moves forward and down.

YES.how: A fist (S hand) nods up and down at the wrist, like a head nodding.

NO.how: Index and middle fingers close down onto the thumb, like a mouth snapping shut.

HELP.how: Thumbs-up fist rests on the flat palm of the other hand; both lift up together.

STOP.how: Side of one flat hand chops down onto the palm of the other.

START.how: Index finger goes between the index and middle fingers of the other open hand and twists.

FOCUS.how: Both flat hands beside the eyes, like blinders, move forward.

REST.how: Both flat hands cross over the chest.

FINISH.how: Both open hands, palms in, flip out to palms forward.

WATER.how: W hand (three fingers up) taps the chin.

TIME.how: Index finger taps the back of the other wrist, where a watch would be.

PLEASE.how: Flat hand on the chest moves in a circle.

ME.how: Index finger points to your own chest.

GOOD.how: Flat hand from the chin moves down onto the other palm.

BAD.how: Flat hand from the chin flips down, palm out.

MORE.how: Both flat-O hands tap fingertips together twice.

AGAIN.how: Bent hand arcs over and lands in the other palm.

WAIT.how: Both open hands, palms up, wiggle the fingers.

NOT.how: Thumb of an A hand flicks forward from under the chin.

NEED.how: Bent index finger (X hand) bobs down twice.

WANT.how: Both clawed hands, palms up, pull toward you.

LIKE.how: Thumb and middle finger pull away from the chest and close.

UNDERSTAND.how: Index finger flicks up beside the forehead.

KNOW.how: Fingertips of a bent hand tap the forehead.

LEARN.how: Fingers pick from the other palm and move to the forehead.

STUDY.how: Fingers wiggle toward the other flat palm.

WORK.how: S hand taps the back of the other S hand at the wrist.

READ.how: V hand moves down over the other flat palm, like eyes scanning.

WRITE.how: Pinched fingers 'write' across the other flat palm.

HOMEWORK.how: Flat-O at the cheek (HOME), then WORK.

PHONE.how: Y hand held at the ear like a handset.

MUSIC.how: Flat hand swings back and forth over the other forearm.

QUIET.how: Index finger to the lips, then both hands lower, palms down.

TIRED.how: Bent hands on the chest droop downward.

HUNGRY.how: C hand moves down the chest.

DRINK.how: C hand tips toward the mouth like a cup.

BATHROOM.how: T hand shakes side to side.

SLEEP.how: Open hand closes as it moves down over the face.

HAPPY.how: Flat hand brushes up the chest in circles.

SAD.how: Both open hands slide down in front of the face.

SORRY.how: A hand (fist) circles on the chest.

FRIEND.how: Index fingers hook together, then swap.

YOU.how: Index finger points at the other person.

MY.how: Flat palm placed on your chest.

NAME.how: Two H hands tap together, middle fingers crossing.

WHAT.how: Both open hands, palms up, shake side to side.

WHERE.how: Index finger up, wags side to side.

WHO.how: Index finger circles in front of the lips.

HOW.how: Bent hands back to back roll forward and up.

WHY.how: Fingers touch the forehead, then pull out into a Y hand.

NOW.how: Both bent hands, palms up, drop down together.

LATER.how: L hand pivots forward at the thumb, next to the other palm.

_other.how: NOT a sign: scratch your face, drink, wave, stretch, fix your hair, type. Teaches the model to ignore it.
